# Native primary pooled estimate persistence

This five-path candidate adapts `FirstLevelFixedEffectsEstimatePlan` directly to
`EstimateSink`. One native execution pools complete coefficient precisions,
then applies the selected numeric L. It persists effects, requested marginal SE
and upper-triangle absolute covariance. It does not refit or average scalar
contrasts. Its physical route is the existing Core-1 `PairNifti` encoding.

Each primary product is `PooledRuns`, including a selected single run. The full
selected support includes excluded samples. Their finite zero fills carry
explicit invalid codes. Native `NoObservedResponses` maps to `MissingInput`,
`NonFinite` to `NumericalFailure`, and the remaining inference refusals to
`NonEstimable`. Core validity is coarser than native status. With the current
native finite-input policy, nonfinite response reads fail and abort the whole
publication; the mapping is not evidence that this executor publishes such
responses as individual exclusions.

Covariance is already absolute and varies by sample. There is no residual scale
product and no extra multiplication. Marginal uncertainty records Unknown:
variance is estimated from run residual variances, while effective df for
estimated inverse-covariance pooling are unavailable. Summed run residual df are
persisted as explicitly descriptive nominal accounting. No effective/reference
df or StudentT calibration is claimed.

The realized binding copies the native readout aligned to the actual common
pooled coefficient axis, in exact column order. Catalog mapping checks identity,
cardinality, uniqueness, kind, common units, unit scope and native-coordinate
normalization. `PooledFitEstimateProducer.normalization(prepared,row)` exposes
that coordinate receipt for caller catalog construction. It retains actual
basis scaling and response functionals without changing coefficients. Ordinary
coefficient/linear-contrast physical units remain caller declarations; response
functionals are checked against their native response-value/integral units.
Acquisitions follow actual selected `partition.runIndex`, with run-local scans
from each partition's actual timepoints. Each contributing run's admitted
QR rank, df, method, tolerance and convention remain in provenance. The pooled
FullRank receipt concerns the common axis and positive summed precision; its
scalar tolerance is explicitly the maximum reported native threshold.

Before reading, the adapter requires the exact compiled sink declaration,
requested full pair-axis capability and sufficient per-call block capacity.
Retained-run requests are refused at construction. Shared-table covariance is
refused. Callback Left/throw, reader failure and cancellation abort the sink,
including cancellation after final delivery; only completed execution seals.
The reader and backend remain caller-owned. The adapter retains one native
block's output matrices and per-call delivery buffers; it retains no previous
response/output blocks. Native plan/support/catalog/sink metadata costs remain.

A publication can be bound directly to a group input:

```scala
val producer = PooledFitEstimateProducer.make(
  prepared, publicationIdentity, catalog, selectedEstimandIds, "scanner"
).toOption.get
val sink = store.newSink(
  producer.unit, prepared.maxBlockVoxels, CovarianceLayout.PairNifti
).toOption.get
val pinned = producer.write(datasetReader, sink).toOption.get
val input = GroupEstimateInput(
  pinned,
  publicationIdentity.observation,
  producer.unit.products.find(_.kind == ProductKind.Effect).get.id,
  producer.unit.products.find(_.kind == ProductKind.StandardError)
    .map(p => GroupMarginalUncertainty.StandardError(p.id))
)
```

The JVM probe executes this native producer → seal → pinned-input sequence for
two independent participants. Its consumer reads after relocation in a fresh
process, with native fitter, adapters, fixtures and producer entry point absent.
Consumer geometry/method admission is explicit; readable numeric SE does not
supply a pooled-df calibration or authorize an inferential method.

Independent evidence uses full-rank two-run X with X'X=P1/P2,
P1=[[2,1],[1,2]], P2=[[3,-1],[-1,1]]. Residual directions are orthogonal
to both columns and realize variance scales (1,1), (1,4), (1,2). Independent
2x2 inverses give Sigma0=diag(1/5,1/3),
Sigma1=[[2/5,-2/15],[-2/15,22/45]], and
Sigma2=[[5/17,-1/17],[-1/17,7/17]]. The signed readout is
L=[[1,-2],[1,0],[-1/2,3/2]]. The off-diagonal shape change rules out one
shared U times a scalar. Tests compare all effects/SE/pairs and c'Sigma c,
reordered physical samples and catalog IDs, blocks 1/2/3 over five samples,
effects-only/marginal/Joint, mixed/all exclusions, before-I/O refusals,
cancellation and returned/thrown failures. JVM readback checks every stored
value and validity, native operators/scans/pooling, and absolute covariance
with variance scale 1. A pooled row and a constituent run are refused together by the pooling-scope
guard. A separate homogeneous pooled duplicate-participant control verifies the
independent-subject guard.

Actual gates, complete raw logs, source/provider/runtime inventories,
probe commands and actual exit receipts are bound below.
No queued job is qualification. Resource observations are small synthetic
64 MiB maximum-heap jobs, endpoint heap samples and process RSS; no peak total
memory, scalability or throughput claim follows.

The parent Core ticket remains open for run retention, legacy replacement,
workflow binding, HDF5, downstream W5 and broader access/power-loss gates.
This local candidate requires independent SHA-bound review before adoption.
